annotations.title: Hazmat table rows for a UN number

description: What does the US hazardous materials table (49 CFR 172.101) say for a UN/NA number (e.g. UN1993)? Proper shipping name, hazard class, packing group, labels, special provisions decoded, packaging sections and quantity limits. More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

provisions.description: "full" (each special provision, symbol and vessel code decoded with its text and CFR paragraph) or "codes" (just the codes). Default full.
